title: After the Satsuki Sho: One Crown Down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer pushes herself to her limit and wins the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan congratulates her after the race. She also comments on how Mejiro Palmer looks fiercer than she used to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is proof she has started to show at least a little bit of her true self. She vows to continue to change how others see her.
